variables.name: ADMIN_EMAIL
variables.description: Admin email address (placeholder is fine — no SMTP configured)

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Admin password — auto-generated, min 8 chars. Copy from the Variables tab after deploy.

variables.name: PUFFER_PANEL_REGISTRATIONENABLED
variables.description: Allow public self-registration (false = invite-only via admin-created accounts)

variables.name: PLAYIT_SECRET
variables.description: Optional playit.gg agent secret for UDP game tunnels (Valheim/Rust/7DTD/CS2). Get it at playit.gg; port mappings are managed in the playit dashboard. Leave empty if you only host TCP games (e.g. Minecraft).
